desc:
🛹 Welcome to Skate For Brainrots 🛹

😈I bet, you can't skateboard better than me!😈

1. Use your Skateboard to reach OP Brainrots!
2. Run back to your base before they catch you!🏃 
3. Make sure not to fall into the void!🤾‍♂️
4. Bring brainrots back to your Base to earn Cash! 💵
5. Upgrade your speed and jump to get further! 🎁
6. Become the most richer in the game 🔓

💤 Your Brainrots earns Cash offline! 
📜 Join our group! Maybe we will implement it in the game. Let us know what you think.
🛡️ Admin Abuse every Wednesday or Saturday at 18PM GMT
